collection.title: Vauxhall Movano 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Vauxhall Movano 2021 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
